name: Myonion
description: Myonion is a meme token creation and trading platform inspired by pump.fun. It allows users to generate tokens, trade them instantly, and migrate them into a built in mini DEX for long term liquidity. It combines token creation and trading within one interface.
short_description: myOnion.fun is a groundbreaking platform built on the Alephium blockchain, inspired by the popular pump.fun.
